# Carmel Christian School — Financial Aid & Tuition (Deep-Dive Report)

**Provenance**

- **Compiled by:** Claude Code deep research pass (`/implement add-carmel-christian`).
- **Date compiled:** 2026-08-16
- **Method:** Tuition/fees/discounts transcribed verbatim from the school's own published
 PDF (S1, dated December 5, 2025). Aid % is THIRD-PARTY (PrivateSchoolReview), not
 school-confirmed. School files no 990 (church-exempt); the Foundation 990 is a related
 entity.

| Grades 9-12 | $18,750 | $500 (re-enrollment) | Technology (Chromebook + insurance) **9th grade only** $550; **Senior Fee** $200; "athletics, fine arts, AP classes, Impact Week & Senior Trip" (unpriced) |

**Discounts:** Carmel Baptist Church Member $600/child · Multi-child $600/child, **applies
beginning with the 3rd child enrolled**. "Enrollment fees must be paid in full at time of
enrollment."

**International student tuition:** a separate "2026-2027 International Student Tuition" PDF
is referenced on S2 but was not fetched — TO VERIFY, figures not captured.

- **Carmel Christian School itself files NO 990** — church-exempt ministry of Carmel Baptist
 Church. ProPublica returns "Nonprofits (0)" for the school (S7).
- **RELATED: Carmel Educational Foundation, EIN 56-2107877** (Matthews NC; 501(c)(3) since
 Feb 2000; FY ends July 31):

| FY (end Jul 31) | Total Revenue | Total Expenses | Net Assets |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2025 | $1,068,745 | $618,023 | $1,894,088 |
| 2024 | $1,049,257 | $532,350 | $1,530,281 |
| 2023 | $806,345 | $329,090 | $1,013,374 |

FY2025 contributions ≈ $1,000,001 (~93.6% of revenue). **No separate scholarship/grant
line** itemized. The Foundation-to-school link is probable but not explicitly stated, so it
does NOT yield a school-level aid figure.
